The '''HR-IO4 ion railgun''' was a type of ion [[Railgun/Legends|rail gun]] produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted HR-IO4 had an extraordinary range, firing ion particles enclosed in a magnetic field in order to cause severe damage to enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]' shields and drain weapon and engine power.<ref name="Starfighter" />
